lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular pixel clusters organized into roughly five horizontal rows and numerous vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, extending across the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs to form a regular coordinate-like matrix of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank; each is defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient, with high-intensity highlights on the dorsal edge and low-intensity shadows on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, high-luminance circular spots scattered across the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin, with higher concentration toward the base and anterior margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A minor irregular indentation is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin; multiple dark, elongated silhouettes (commensal organisms) are attached to the ventral-lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: A sharp transition in spot morphology is observed from dense, small punctate clusters on the cranial region to larger, systematically spaced blobs on the trunk.
